Package index

Run and translate SAS programs

Entry points. Run a SAS program on the R engine or translate it into tidyverse R code.

sas_run()
Run a SAS program on the R engine
sas_translate()
Translate a SAS program into R (tidyverse) code
sas_check()
List the unsupported features of a SAS program
sas_session()
Create a persistent session
sas_work() sas_session_add() sas_meta() sas_macro_vars() sas_listing() sas_session_close()
Inspect a session
sas_log()
The log of a result or a session
sas_html()
The HTML document of a result
sas_export_work()
Write WORK data sets as CSV files with an attribute table
sasonr_strict sasonr.strict
Strict mode: approximate and unsupported features fail loud

The translation as an R script

A runnable script for a translation or for the trace of a run, and the step verbs it calls.

sas_script()
The translation of a SAS program as an R script
sas_data_step() sas_proc_sort() sas_proc_means() sas_proc_sql() sas_proc() sas_options() sas_title() sas_global() sas_deferred()
Run one SAS step in a session
sasonr_tidy_log()
Show tidylog messages for an expression

Front end (lexer, parser, analysis)

sas_lex()
Tokenize SAS source code
sas_parse()
Parse a SAS program
sas_parse_expr()
Parse a single SAS expression
sas_analyze()
Analyse a parsed DATA step
